headline: India's Russian crude imports hit record for second straight month - OrissaPOST
summary: India's imports of Russian crude oil rose to a record for a second consecutive month in July, worth 5.5 billion euros, up 2.1 per cent. Western sanctions have tightened restrictions on Russian energy exports.
why: India is a major oil importer, and its purchases of discounted Russian crude influence global crude flows and sanctions enforcement.
